title: Notice to Owners: Right to Return a Deferred Fixed Annuities Contract
content:
The owner of an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract may return the contract for a refund of the premium paid less any withdrawals.

## Time limit

The returned contract must be received no later than the contract delivery date plus the free-look days. The free-look end is found by adding the free-look days in calendar days to the contract delivery date; a contract received on that day is in time.

- The contract delivery date and the facts below are those on the contract record (delivery date, whether the sale replaced another policy, and the owner's issue age).
- When the contract replaced another annuity or life policy, the replacement free-look period replaces the standard free-look days.
- When the owner's age on the issue date was the senior free-look age or more, the senior free-look period replaces it.
- When both apply, the longer period governs.

## Exchange and transfer money

Exchange or transfer proceeds are returned to the company they came from where the owner asks.

## Counting the period (hypothetical dates, using the schedule figures of 10, 30 and 30 days and the senior age of 60)

| Owner and sale | Period | Delivery date | Free-look end | Received on the end date | Received the day after |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Owner aged 45, new money | 10 days | 5 June | 15 June | In time | Late |
| Owner aged 45, replacement sale | 30 days | 5 June | 5 July | In time | Late |
| Owner aged 60, new money | 30 days | 5 June | 5 July | In time | Late |
| Owner aged 59, new money | 10 days | 5 June | 15 June | In time | Late |
| Owner aged 66, replacement sale | 30 days (the longer of the two) | 5 June | 5 July | In time | Late |

**Refund illustration (hypothetical).** Premium paid $50000, withdrawals $2000: the refund is $48000.
